assessment_objectives.objective: Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are developed to assist organizational management in performance monitoring, trend analysis and possible control redesign or replacement for the organization's Security, Compliance & Resilience Program (SCRP).
Key Performance Indicator (KPI) results are reported to organizational management per an organization-defined frequency.
Key Performance Indicator (KPI) results are used to identify Security, Compliance & Resilience Program (SCRP) controls that may require redesign or replacement.
